authoringRules: One scene makes one causal point; use short explanatory headings.
Introduce a concrete case before definitions.
Put labels beside what they describe; preserve actor colours.
Let the learner vary a meaningful condition, without autoplay or fake progress.
Keep assumptions and exceptions near the example.
Connect the explanation to the existing answer practice and primary source.
Never convert every paragraph into a decorative card.
